about: Krish's one-off setup actions for engine v2 (docs/ENGINE-V2.md, Krish's actions). engine/actions.py closes each one itself when its done_when check passes; a 'manual' one closes only when a session records his confirmation here with the date, never on its own guess. Order is the order he is asked.

actions.text: Switch Full Time to handcrafted in Control Center (one click), so every approved post comes back to you to post by hand.
Listen to the whole Liverpool v8 mix once, on headphones, and give it one verdict: post it, change it (say what), or bin it.
Approve briefs/2026-10-27-decision-log-rulings.md and start a full-time session with it, so the per-take ruling (D1 and ORGANIC) comes into force.
Approve the two product briefs (share attribution and rail supply) so a full-time session can build them.

Create the Full Time handles on YouTube (a Brand Account), TikTok and Instagram (Business) first, with one handle everywhere and the brand inbox, never a personal email. Then reserve Threads, X, Facebook and a WhatsApp Channel.
Connect the three Full Time channels to Buffer and put their Buffer channel IDs in local/buffer-channels.json (copy examples/buffer-channels.example.json).
Start a Control Center session with briefs/2026-10-27-control-center-measurement.md, so its directive carries ga4_landings and registers the two new objective keys.
Run the Cowork prompt in briefs/2026-10-27-cowork-canva-brand-kit.md on your PC: the Full Time brand kit and six templates in Canva, built from the approved social kit.
Let a session on your PC run scripts/baseline.py over your Codex and Claude logs, so the 20x cost target has a real baseline.
